commentary: Almost every link in the valuation chain has moved since the prior report, rather than a single input: the cost of debt and cost of equity, the debt and equity weights and the resulting WACC all differ, as do the projected revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, capex, depreciation and working-capital lines that feed free cash flow, and the discount factors applied to them. Both terminal approaches have been restated — the Gordon calculation and the exit-multiple calculation, together with the implied terminal growth and implied exit multiple that read back from them — so the enterprise value, equity value, value per share, implied upside and the disagreement between methods shown here are not comparable line-by-line with what the prior report carried. The only movement outside the model chain is a debt instrument face amount attached to a fiscal period ending in April 2013, which speaks to the underlying disclosure rather than to the forecast.
